summary: End-to-end verification of the new Special Needs Co-Parenting v2 product. Backend API integration tests (11 new) + existing unit tests (9) all pass. Frontend picker, 8-step assessment, autosave, and cached report page fully render with correct data-testids. Applied a small frontend fix to make Likert/textarea/option testids fully qualified with the question id (they used to collide when multiple pathways were shown side-by-side).
critical_code_review_comments: snc2_routes: bulk answer validation aborts the whole batch on the first bad key with 400 -- OK per spec, but the caller has no per-key error map. Consider returning invalid_keys array.
snc2_report_pdf: fpdf2 DeprecationWarnings on ln= / dest= (v2.5.2+). Cosmetic; migrate to new_x/new_y and BytesIO output.
snc2_routes /report/pdf: builds PDF on every request from the cached JSON (no PDF caching). Fine for now but could be memoised alongside the report doc if PDF size or load grows.

SpecialNeedsV2.jsx: pre-fix bug -- Likert/OptionButtons/textarea used `item.id` (e.g. `current_impact`) for their testids, causing duplicate DOM ids whenever more than one pathway rendered on the same step. Fixed by threading the fully-qualified qid through ItemInput.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of contract testids present, picker/assessment/report/dashboard flows all working

test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123! (JWT) -- but the frontend login flow was not exercised; guest auto-bootstrap (guest_*@demo.local session cookie) was used instead because JWT tokens are not stored in localStorage and the login form submission from the automation harness kept returning 401 in preview. All /api/snc2/* endpoints were exercised via both pytest (JWT bearer) and the browser (guest cookie).
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run registers a fresh TEST_parent_*@test.com user via conftest.py. Frontend session used a bootstrapped guest identity; a set of 12 scored answers was posted through /api/snc2/answers/bulk to exercise the report flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New product lives at /special-needs-v2 (frontend) and /api/snc2/* (backend). Question ids follow `{step_id}_{pathway}_{item_id}`. Guardrail assertions to keep: none of 'correct parent', 'wrong parent', 'winner', 'right parent', 'incorrect parent' anywhere in report payload or PDF bytes. Composite bands (Well aligned / Generally aligned / Coordination opportunity / Significant inconsistency / Priority concern / Not enough data) and impact bands (High / Notable / Moderate / Limited / Minimal reported impact) are NORMAL, not guardrail violations. The frontend testids for interactive answer widgets are now `snc2-{qid}-opt-{value}` (Likert) and `snc2-{qid}-input` (textarea/input) — verified with medical+educational side-by-side, zero duplicate testids on the DOM. Old /api/snc/*, /api/family-report/* endpoints correctly return 404.
rca of the issue: Frontend `ItemInput` was passing `item.id` down to Likert/OptionButtons, which meant when the schema returned two pathway blocks (e.g. step1 medical + step1 educational) both rendered a `snc2-current_impact-opt-4` button — duplicate DOM ids and mismatched with the spec's `snc2-step1_medical_current_impact-opt-4` contract. Fix: thread the parent-scope `qid` (`${step.id}_${pw.id}_${item.id}`) into ItemInput and use it for the child testids. Backend was unaffected.
